accuracyFlags: 'Collecting firewood is prohibited in most national parks': broadly true but rules differ by state and park; unsourced.
'Dingoes on K'gari ... have caused serious injuries and deaths': defensible but unsourced and presented as fact about the whole island with no QLD Parks link.

'Many arid parks now require carrying (toilet waste) out entirely' and 'total fire ban: no open flame at all' are overgeneralised (fire-ban rules differ by state, gas cookers are often allowed): needs state-fire-authority links.
Duplicated content: the 'never feed native animals' paragraph appears twice (section 06 and again at end of 08); several 'Keep in mind' chips repeat body text.
